caller.text:
$COPX  after an 8 month pause is looking to break out again.  

Still deserves a small allocation in long term accounts

parent.text:
Some smart people talk about a massive copper shortage and not enough supply in development. 

Then this multi-decade chart supports the view we could see >$10 price.

Worth a small allocation to Copper miners for the long term folks.  Cash some of the energy positions.
